segments.text:
Thoſe that have this pretious faith wrought in them by the Spirit, can never finally nor totally fall away; and though many ſtormes and floods do ariſe and beat againſt them, yet they ſhall never be able to take them off that foundation and rock which by faith they are faſtened upon, but ſhall be kept by the power of God to ſalvation,
where they ſhall enjoy their purchaſed poſſeſſion, they being formerly engraven upon the palms of Gods hands.
